scope.notes: More than 20 files across Studio storage/admission/readiness/authoring/dispatch/history, worker configuration, OpenAPI, frontend API/MSW/management/history, and real concurrency tests.

integration.notes: New internal Studio schedule APIs and background authorization seam integrate existing Vault, immutable revisions and runner dispatch; real external principal integration stays a release gate.

infrastructure.notes: Forward-only V26 adds owned schedule/occurrence/ack tables, ownership constraints, scheduled ledger identity, durable uncertainty and partition-safe trigger attribution; no new service.

knowledge.notes: Existing Java21/Spring/JDBC/PostgreSQL/React/MUI patterns reused; new atomic occurrence, DST suppression and failclosed background authorization composition verified by source and primary docs.

risk.notes: Duplicate UI effects, lost atomic acceptance, callback lock inversions, revoked unattended grants and ambiguity after history pruning are core trust risks requiring PostgreSQL race and rollback evidence.
